boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will call may be picked up at the Box Office window on the night of the event, after doors open.

venues.parkingDetail: Parking is available in lots on the north side of the building and diagonally north-east across the street (in black gated lots). After 6pm, additional parking is available in the Whole Person lot at 37th and Main. Street parking is also available; please adhere to locally posted rules.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: The building is wheelchair accessible, floor seating is available to people with accessibility needs and there is an elevator to the balcony.

venues.name: Uptown Theater

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Box office is only open on day of event. Hours vary by event.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call can be picked up begining 1 hour prior to event. Box office is located at the front of the club. Must have confirmation number, a valid picture ID, and the actual credit card the tickets were puchased with. If a parent purchases tickets for their children, please send a letter giving permission to pick up tickets along with the confirmation number and a copy of the cardholders drivers license. Prefer to have ID with the child also.

venues.parkingDetail: There is plenty of free parking on the streets surrounding The Uptown, along with a lot on the north side of the building.
